caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular piece of woven fabric centered on a plain background, bordered by a thin, single-line rectangular frame. The fabric displays a geometric pattern composed of repeating squares and rectangles in shades of green, red, blue, and white. The green and red squares are arranged in an alternating checkerboard fashion, while blue lines run horizontally and vertically throughout the pattern, creating a grid effect. White spaces separate the colored blocks, enhancing the pattern’s prominence. The edges of the fabric are frayed, with threads extending outward, and individual strands of blue, green, and red are visible at the boundaries. The drawing is signed in the lower right corner with the name “W.O. Fletcher.”
title: Handwoven Coverlet
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
